name: EverStamp: Timestamped Photos & Videos
tagline: Timestamped photos and videos anyone can verify
maker_comment_excerpt: Hi Product Hunters, Joeri here, with my co-founder Arjen, from the Netherlands. We kept running into the same kind of argument: the rental car that "already had that scratch". The meter readings nobody wrote down when the keys changed hands. The parcel that arrived damaged, or did it? Everyone had photos. They settled nothing.
